# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Core: Topics and first publication

## Core: Topics and first publication

- [Stage 00: Create your project folder](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-00-setup.md): Open the empty my-audacity-guide folder in DogsBay XML, add a topics folder, and optionally start tracking it with Git.
- [Stage 01: A concept topic](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-01-concept.md): Write What is Audacity? as a DITA concept, learn the parts every topic has, and check your work.
- [Stage 02: First map](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-02-first-map.md): Add your first topic to a DITA map and select the map as the project root.
- [Stage 03: First build](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-03-first-build.md): Define an HTML deliverable, build the guide with DITA-OT, and inspect its generated pages.
- [Stage 04: A task and a reference](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-04-task-and-reference.md): Write Recording your first track as a task and Supported audio formats as a reference, and learn why DITA has three information types.
- [Stage 05: Inline and block elements](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-05-inline-and-block.md): Mark up UI controls, menu paths, terms and file paths inline; add notes, definition lists, ordered and simple lists, footnotes, simple tables and code blocks.
- [Stage 06: Rich tasks](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-06-rich-tasks.md): Write four more tasks that use prerequisites, substeps, choices, a choice table, step examples and results, troubleshooting, and unordered steps.
- [Stage 07: Links](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-07-links.md): Add cross-references inside the text and related links at the end of each topic, link to a section by id, and link out to the web.
